verdict.rationale: BILL's documented v3 REST API explicitly covers Spend & Expense, including managing transactions and reimbursements (docs-1, docs-2, docs-23). S&E calls authenticate with an apiToken (docs-19), but nothing shows OAuth or scoped tokens, and receipt retrieval is never mentioned. missing for 10: OAuth authorization flow, scoped/least-privilege tokens, documented receipt/attachment retrieval endpoints, explicit expense-read endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), independent hands-on corroboration.
